program_text='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for color in row:
            counts[color] = counts.get(color, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
    if not points:
        return out
    cr = sum(r for r, c in points) / len(points)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in points) / len(points)
    seen = set()
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, rc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= rc < w and grid[rr][rc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, rc))
                    rr += dr
                    rc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                seen.update(run)
                ends = (run[0], run[-1])
                end = max(ends, key=lambda p: (p[0]-cr)**2 + (p[1]-cc)**2)
                step_r = -dr if end == run[0] else dr
                step_c = -dc if end == run[0] else dc
                rr, rc = end[0] + step_r, end[1] + step_c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= rc < w:
                    if out[rr][rc] == background:
                        out[rr][rc] = color
                    rr += step_r
                    rc += step_c
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(program_text)
